name: Google Playground
desc: Labs experiment that turns text prompts into playable games
desc_zh: 把文字提示变成可玩游戏的 Google Labs 实验平台
solves: Making a game meant learning an engine; Playground builds a playable version from a description you can remix.
solves_zh: 做游戏原本要学引擎，Playground 按一段描述生成能玩的版本，还能继续改。
best_for: A party is coming up and you want a custom quiz game for your friends by tonight.
best_for_zh: 周末有聚会，想今晚就给朋友们做一款定制的问答游戏。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — https://labs.google/ (current experiments)）。 Early experiment from Google Labs; the second quote is a verbatim prefix (the sentence continues with tiered creation access). Product Hunt featured 'Gemini Robotics 2.5' near this date, not this product. Second source is not independent media. 入库核对（2026-11-25）：「Playground」单写认不出属于谁，也与 Google AI Studio 的 playground 一词撞名。 首次公开日期来源：https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/technology/ai/playground-experimental-gaming-platform/
